Author: yocopk
Name: MogHouse Companion
Punchline: Quality-of-life tools that connect your game to MogHouse. First up: timers pushed to your phone.
Description:
Companion plugin for MogHouse (mog-house.com).

An all-in-one home for quality-of-life tools that link FINAL FANTASY XIV to your MogHouse account. Tools are added over time; each one can be switched on or off individually, and nothing leaves the game unless you enable it.

Available now — Timers: reads the timers you already see in the game's own Timers window (CTRL+U), including submarine and airship voyages, retainer ventures, map and leve allowances, custom deliveries and allied society dailies, and syncs them to your profile. MogHouse then pushes you a notification the moment one comes up, on web and mobile, even while the game and your PC are off.

The plugin is read-only: it collects your own data and reports status. It never performs an in-game action.

Open it with /moghouse. Requires a MogHouse account with an active Mog+ subscription.
